data.pattern_assignment: Cycle by clip index, window index, gap index and context, fixed before fitting
data.sampling: Unique starts within each clip/gap, fixed sorted random sample; context frames included only when enabled
data.rest_calibration: Artificial BVH frame0, never a motion sample or target
data.bucket_storage: Separate finite float32 arrays by exact sequence length; boolean masks. No pickle.

training.direct_loss: unknown position MSE +0.1 rotation6 MSE +0.01 velocity MSE +0.0001 acceleration MSE; derivatives use actual seconds and exclude all-known differences
training.diffusion_loss: Same clean-sequence loss, random cosine-noise level per sample; observed residuals clamped0
training.selection: Fixed final epoch. No development-set checkpoint selection. Nonfinite/memory/time failure preserves partial evidence and is not a completed fit.

evaluation.old_new_and_combined_development: All unchanged original gates, separately. Established control reports must be unchanged.
evaluation.additional: Full/multiple/partial authored controls, supported sequence lengths, response to edits, finite normalized rotations, actual rig projection and full source recovery
evaluation.confirmation: Six protected clips stay sealed until every development gate passes and candidates/protocol are frozen

require_before_fitting: Verified frozen cache manifest and training-only identities
Actual exported NumPy inference parity at2,33,120frames including exact observations
No accidental loading of validation or confirmation
Deterministic CPU export and seeded training recipe
